# polytomic_amazon_rds_postgresql_connection (Data Source)

Amazon RDS PostgreSQL Connection

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polytomic_amazon_rds_postgresql_connection" "amazon_rds_postgresql" {
  id = "aab123aa-27f3-abc1-9999-abcde123a4aa"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `organization` (String)

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)

### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Read-Only:
